visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a large, halved rice ball wrapped in clear plastic. A hand pulls the two halves apart, revealing a steaming, soft interior with a bright yellow, runny egg yolk spilling out over brown braised meat and crispy fried dough. The background is a blurred street scene. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a woman behind a food stall counter; she has grey hair, wears a red floral mask and a blue apron over a purple shirt. She smiles and gestures with her hands while talking to the camera in a cramped indoor stall filled with kitchen equipment like fans and shelves. (3) A close-up series shows the assembly of the rice ball on a plastic sheet: first a bed of white sticky rice, then spoonfuls of brown radishes, fluffy pinkish-brown pork floss, a halves of a salted egg, a scoop of dark braised meat sauce, a whole fried egg, and a large golden-brown crispy dough stick. Hands use a metal tong to carefully place the ingredients. (4) The camera shows two fully wrapped, large oval rice balls held in two hands against a blurred background. Then, another halved rice ball is shown with a deep yellow salted egg and a runny fried egg yolk visible. (5) A plastic cup of iced coffee is shown. A hand pours dark coffee from a metal shaker into a cup containing milk and ice, creating a swirling marble effect. (6) The final shots show the storefront of 'San Li Fan Tuan' (三立飯糰) with a red and white sign, a red menu board with yellow text, and a white sign on the street corner next to a red-and-white striped pole. The setting is an outdoor urban street with a tree and some parked motorcycles.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你有吃過. [Logo]: @hooleefun. (2) [Subtitle]: 荷包蛋飯糰嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 聽說這家很多人從小吃到大. (4) [Subtitle]: (飯糰總共做了). (5) [Subtitle]: (快16~17年了哦). (6) [Subtitle]: 自己煮的糯米加上菜脯, 肉鬆. (7) [Subtitle]: 我們選的鹹蛋還有肉燥. (8) [Subtitle]: 和荷包蛋脆脆的油條. (9) [Subtitle]: 小顆的分量就很飽足. (10) [Subtitle]: 這個是最多人點的招牌荷包蛋飯糰. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們更喜歡雙蛋飯糰. (12) [Subtitle]: 荷包蛋加整顆鹹蛋吃起來更豐富. (13) [Subtitle]: 飲料可以試試現泡咖啡加高牧牛奶. (14) [Subtitle]: 蠻順口的. (15) [Subtitle]: 飯糰都是限量建議先預訂. (16) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Slogan]: 三立飯糰 高雄市三民區莊敬路116號. (17) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice-over narrating in a bright, friendly tone. Behind him, a high-tempo, major-key electronic pop track plays with a steady, driving drum beat. The music is consistent and provides a positive, upbeat energy to the introduction. (2) A brief female voice interjects, sounding like a shop owner; her tone is warm and conversational as she provides background info on the shop. There's a subtle metallic clink of tongs and the faint rustle of plastic in the background, signifying a busy food stall environment. (3) The male narrator returns, describing the food ingredients with high enthusiasm. His speech rate is fast and clear, matching the energetic BGM. The music continues without pauses, maintaining a light and promotional atmosphere through the end of the clip, blending seamlessly with the fast-paced narration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Intro -> Process Showcase -> Product Feature -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'San Li Fan Tuan' (三立飯糰), a long-standing rice ball stall in Kaohsiung. It uses appetizing close-ups of runny egg yolks and diverse fillings to create visual craving, supported by a friendly interview with the owner and a detailed ingredient reveal to build trust and local authenticity.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the shop, provides the address, shows the menu, and the creators ('虎麗笑嗨嗨') are known food influencers recommending the product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High production value for social media, utilizing fast-paced editing and bright colors to appeal to food lovers.
